unit_conversion_notes.precipitation: ERA5-Land total_precipitation_sum m -> mm; Open-Meteo precipitation_sum is returned in mm/day and is written directly.
unit_conversion_notes.relative_humidity_max: 100 * es(dewpoint_temperature_2m_max) / es(temperature_2m_min), clipped to 0..100; Open-Meteo relative_humidity_2m_max is returned in percent and clipped to 0..100.
unit_conversion_notes.relative_humidity_min: 100 * es(dewpoint_temperature_2m_min) / es(temperature_2m_max), clipped to 0..100; Open-Meteo relative_humidity_2m_min is returned in percent and clipped to 0..100.
unit_conversion_notes.shortwave_radiation: ERA5-Land surface_solar_radiation_downwards_sum retained as J m-2 day-1; Open-Meteo shortwave_radiation_sum is returned in MJ m-2 day-1 and converted to J m-2 day-1 by multiplying by 1e6. Canonical stored unit is J m-2 day-1.
unit_conversion_notes.specific_humidity: 0.622 * mean(es(tdmax), es(tdmin)) / (surface_pressure - 0.378 * mean(es(tdmax), es(tdmin))); Derived from Open-Meteo dew_point_2m_mean (degC) and surface_pressure_mean (hPa): 0.622 * e(dewpoint) / (pressure - 0.378 * e).
unit_conversion_notes.tb_19ve: AMSR 18.7V brightness temperature is retained in K-compatible native units.
unit_conversion_notes.tb_37ve: AMSR 36.5V brightness temperature is retained in K-compatible native units.
unit_conversion_notes.tmax: ERA5-Land temperature_2m_max K -> degC; Open-Meteo temperature_2m_max is returned in degC and is written directly.
unit_conversion_notes.tmin: ERA5-Land temperature_2m_min K -> degC; Open-Meteo temperature_2m_min is returned in degC and is written directly.
unit_conversion_notes.wind_velocity: sqrt(u_component_of_wind_10m^2 + v_component_of_wind_10m^2), m s-1; Open-Meteo wind_speed_10m_max is returned in km/h and converted to m/s by dividing by 3.6.
